segments.text: نَطُو, there is not, in place of Nathu, there must be Nannu.
Nannu evam jeev sankheyye sa tiye sa tiye sa tiye dehe paata prafta.
Na tiye asav suprabh dhassabhi dehna sa tiyev dhrishte tathkatam ayam tazaru du pramiti.
This is question. The question is here, when this way his individuality is destroyed.
In duality is dissolved. I say dehe paata prafta, there is time for him to leave the physical body.
He must leave the physical body at that very moment, as soon as that individuality is finished.
As soon as that individuality is finished, his physical, the existence of his physical body must also finish, side by side.
He must not live in this physical body.
Na tiye asav suprabh dhassabhi dehna sa tiyev dhrishte tathkatam ayam tazaru du pramiti.

Buhta kanchi ki tazaru muhto buha paate samat para. He said to be buhta kanchi ki. His physical frame is maintained only outwardly, not his internal consciousness.
From his internal consciousness point of view, he has no physical body. He is above physical body.
So he is buhta kanchi ki. These five elements are just like covering for him.
He does not insert ego in that. He does not insert eye consciousness in that. He does not say that, I am this body.
This is frame. Let it be. Let it remain like this. So he said to be buhta kanchi ki.
But at that moment, he is buhta absolutely liberated from the pangs of repeated births and deaths. He is muhto buha paate samat para.
